newsitem.title: USA: ATS Medical sees Q4 net of about $391,000.
newsitem.headline: ATS Medical sees Q4 net of about $391,000.

text.p: ATS Medical Inc said Monday it expects to report fourth quarter 1996 net income of about $391,000 versus $219,509 last year on sales of $3.434 million versus $2.611 million.
For the year ended December 31, the company said it expects to report income of about $1.32 million or $0.08 a share, up from $714,524 or $0.05 a share reported for 1995.
The company sees sales for the year at about $11.850 million, compared with $9.301 million last year.
ATS said it expects to release complete 1996 financial results on or about February 10.

ATS, which provides a pyrolytic carbon open pivot mechanical heart valve, said the results were exclusively from sales outside the United States. The company said although it received permission to start U.S. clinical trials late in the fourth quarter, there was no U.S. revenue.

"Since year end, we have been implanting valves in the U.S.," said Manny Villafana, chairman and chief executive of ATS. "The company estimates that over 14,000 valves have been implanted throughout the world and the company continues to receive reports of very favorable patient outcomes."
Villafana said the mid-year approval of the valve for commercial release in Japan was a significant factor in both the sales and profit increases.
"The challenge for 1997 will be to continue to grow in international markets while conducting the U.S. clinical," he said.
